description: Defines the MapState trait for managing stateful map operations in Spark Structured Streaming, including methods for existence check, retrieval, update, iteration, and removal of map entries and state.

classes.name: MapState
classes.description: Interface used for arbitrary stateful operations with the v2 API to capture map value state.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether any user map entry exists for the current grouping key.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the state value for the current grouping key and user map key.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if the user map key is contained in the map for the current grouping key.

methods.name: updateValue
methods.description: Adds or updates the map entry for the current grouping key.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator of user map key-value pairs for the current grouping key.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator of user map keys for the current grouping key.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an iterator of user map values for the current grouping key.

methods.name: removeKey
methods.description: Removes a user map key from the map for the current grouping key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the entire map state for the current grouping key.
